request_current_view: exact typed admission (type(reader) is PolicyCaptureReader, nothing else) and bounded int deadline 1..30000 (bool refused); one absolute creator-process deadline established on entry (time.monotonic() + deadline_ms/1000) spanning capture -> check -> pure admit_policy_bytes decode -> check -> genuine match_supplied with the exact required operations ("search", "sources:read") -> check -> fresh actual read_selection -> check -> exact selected-publication bytes compare -> admission construction -> final post-construction check. Every reader call is capped by min(int(remaining_ms), 30000) (the accepted reader cap) and refused before the call when the remaining budget cannot cover the reader's 1 ms floor. One fixed input-free PolicyRequestError (ValueError, message 'private policy request refused') is raised after the handler with __cause__/__context__ None; a non-Exception BaseException propagates by identity, preserving the owned reader's system interruption and cleanup semantics. The raw credential is used only for the bounded initial match and is cleared from the request entry's own retained frame on success and failure (entry-scope rebind in the outer finally), without changing the fixed content-free error, the shared matcher or interruption identity (not a zeroization claim).

PolicyRequestAdmission: frozen/slots/init=False dataclass, factory-only (its constructor raises the fixed error), redacted repr; binds the admitted principal match (principal_id, real controlled-mapping Grants, operations), the admitted immutable policy's policy_id and authorization_status (SUPPLIED_POLICY_MATCH_ONLY), and the frozen selected publication (PolicySelection record plus the exact selected record bytes) together with the independent semantic policy identity from the pure wire decoder, to the trusted reader under the one absolute deadline; it carries no raw credential.

recheck(deadline_ms): same 1..30000 int validation; foreign creator PID refused before the lock; one nonblocking request-ownership span serializing the latch check, the budget check (original end, 1 ms floor, refused without any reader call even under a fresh-looking per-check timeout), the bounded read, the exact bytes compare, the post-comparison operation cutoff, the latch and the success decision. A contended span refuses with zero observations and does not latch (contention is separately identifiable from an entered observation). An ordinary observation failure after entering the real read (the admitted reader's one content-free PolicyCaptureError for missing, malformed, latched-owner or expired conditions) conservatively latches the admission invalid permanently under the held span: no filesystem or lock cause is inferred from the error and no extra read is made. An observed changed selection latches the same way. The tightened operation cutoff at the caller checks the fixed local observation end (the monotonic time before the real call plus the capped call duration, clipped to the fixed original request end, keeping the existing integer reader limit and the 1 ms lower floor) after the observation and the exact comparison and latches on late completion; the original request end is preserved for any subsequent check and is never reset. A latched admission remains invalid under concurrent use even if the record is restored; a separate request captures and admits fresh bytes (one full wire admission per successful request; later rechecks reopen only the bounded selector, never re-admitting the full wire bytes); the shared reader itself is never latched by a request latch.
